Here is the Python code to fetch and pivot the World Bank JSON data into a wide CSV:

```python
import requests
import pandas as pd

url = "http://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS?date=2001:2010&format=json&per_page=20000"
resp = requests.get(url)
data = resp.json()

rows = []
for item in data[1]:
    rows.append({
        "Country Name": item['country']['value'],
        "Country Code": item['country']['id'],
        "Year": int(item['date']),
        "Value": item['value']
    })

long_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
wide_df = long_df.pivot(index='Country Name', columns='Year', values='Value').reset_index()
# Optional: keep country code separately for later filtering
cc_map = long_df[['Country Name','Country Code']].drop_duplicates()
wide_df = cc_map.merge(wide_df, on='Country Name', how='left')

wide_df.to_csv('wb_gross_savings_2001_2010.csv', index=False)
print(wide_df.head())
print(wide_df.columns.tolist())
```

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wb_gross_savings_2001_2010.csv')
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]

candidates = ['Bahrain', 'Brunei Darussalam', 'China', 'Equatorial Guinea', 'Gabon', 'Iran, Islamic Rep.', 'Kuwait', 'Luxembourg', 'Malaysia', 'Oman', 'Qatar', 'Saudi Arabia', 'Singapore', 'United Arab Emirates']

sub['missing_years'] = sub[years].isna().sum(axis=1)

print(sub[['Country Name','years_above_35','missing_years']].sort_values(by='years_above_35', ascending=False))
```
